analysis.description: This paper explores emergent communication in partially-competitive scenarios using reinforcement learning. It introduces a modified sender-receiver game to assess communication between competitive agents and demonstrates how communication emerges under varying degrees of competition. The study examines the conditions necessary for effective communication, particularly in scenarios where typical learning algorithms have failed. The work aims to reshape perceptions about communication being purely cooperative and to encourage further research in competitive multiagent environments.
